findingsCorrected.evidence: The existing general rule that inflation is not a bottleneck was sound, but the event mapping omitted JavaMonitorInflate and did not explain its cause/duration boundary. OpenJDK 25 GA LightweightSynchronizer::enter can inflate an already-owned monitor with cause Monitor Enter when fast recursive entry is unavailable; LockStack::try_recursive_enter requires the top object to match.
findingsCorrected.consequence: A Monitor Enter cause label or summed inflation durations can be mistaken for other-thread contention, blocked time or hold time, prompting an unjustified primitive replacement.
findingsCorrected.correction: Add JavaMonitorInflate to the event map and a version-scoped A→B→A counterexample, distinguish instrumented inflation duration from acquisition/hold/lifetime, and require following the selected stack/callers to shared versus confined objects before attribution.
findingsCorrected.technicalEvidence: A fresh single-thread isolated probe on Temurin 25.0.3+9/-Xint observed 1000 Monitor Enter inflations for A→B→A and zero target inflations for A→A.

sharedFixtureFiles.README.md:
This is a synthetic diagnostic fixture. src/Scenario.java contains the complete application call path. The selected config is config/run.properties and the launcher passes that path to Scenario.main. There is no native/Unsafe code, callback, agent hook or other publisher of Gate instances in this fixture.
Both monitor-scope modes are intentionally supported by this diagnostic program. Findings only: do not modify its behavior, run it, attach to processes or start recordings.
The archived sample describes an inflation event, not a complete event population. The available evidence is the source, selected config, runtime/settings and this sample. No acquisition-wait, owner-hold or request/SLO evidence is provided.
sharedFixtureFiles.launch/runtime.txt:
Selected launch: java -Xint -Xms32m -Xmx64m -cp classes Scenario config/run.properties
JDK: Eclipse Adoptium Temurin 25.0.3+9-LTS, Windows x86_64, HotSpot
Observed flags: LockingMode=2, UseCompactObjectHeaders=false, UseObjectMonitorTable=false
The quoted numeric flags describe this fixture only; do not force them on another target.
